hookRows.body_you: Astrologers call the Moon 'in fall' in Scorpio, meaning feelings this deep are heavy to carry, and you carry them better than you give yourself credit for.
hookRows.body_they: Astrologers call the Moon 'in fall' in Scorpio, meaning feelings this deep are heavy to carry, and they carry them better than they give themselves credit for.

hookRows.body_you: Plans, messages, and tech get glitchy, and old conversations come back around. Double-check the details, back up what matters, and let the theme be re: review, revise, reconnect. It is a bad time to sign in a hurry and a good one to finish what you already started.
hookRows.body_they: Plans, messages, and tech get glitchy, and old conversations come back around. Double-check the details, back up what matters, and let the theme be re: review, revise, reconnect. It is a bad time to sign in a hurry and a good one to finish what you already started.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: Old flames and old wants resurface, and what you value gets a second look. Not the moment for drastic changes to your look, your relationships, or your spending. Revisit instead of restarting, and save the big call on love or money for after it ends.
hookRows.body_they: Old flames and old wants resurface, and what you value gets a second look. Not the moment for drastic changes to your look, your relationships, or your spending. Revisit instead of restarting, and save the big call on love or money for after it ends.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: Drive turns inward, and pushing straight ahead gets you less than usual. Frustration builds where effort stalls, so use this stretch to rework the plan instead of forcing it. Old angers can resurface; settle them instead of reheating them.
hookRows.body_they: Drive turns inward, and pushing straight ahead gets you less than usual. Frustration builds where effort stalls, so use this stretch to rework the plan instead of forcing it. Old angers can resurface; settle them instead of reheating them.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: Growth goes internal for a while. Instead of new opportunities, the wins come from developing what you already have. Revisit your plans and beliefs, keep what still holds, and the expansion picks back up on the other side.
hookRows.body_they: Growth goes internal for a while. Instead of new opportunities, the wins come from developing what you already have. Revisit your plans and beliefs, keep what still holds, and the expansion picks back up on the other side.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: The rules get reviewed. Commitments and structures you built get tested from the inside, and shortcuts quietly come due. Rework the foundations now and the next stretch of building goes faster.
hookRows.body_they: The rules get reviewed. Commitments and structures you built get tested from the inside, and shortcuts quietly come due. Rework the foundations now and the next stretch of building goes faster.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: The urge to break free turns inward. Instead of sudden outside changes, restlessness builds underneath until what needs changing becomes obvious. Plan the change now and make the move once it ends.
hookRows.body_they: The urge to break free turns inward. Instead of sudden outside changes, restlessness builds underneath until what needs changing becomes obvious. Plan the change now and make the move once it ends.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: Dreams get louder while facts get blurrier. Good for creative work and inner work, bad for big promises. Check what is real twice before betting on it.
hookRows.body_they: Dreams get louder while facts get blurrier. Good for creative work and inner work, bad for big promises. Check what is real twice before betting on it.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: Deep change moves underground. Old power struggles and buried patterns surface for review, not for punishment. What you truly let go of during this stretch tends to stay gone.
hookRows.body_they: Deep change moves underground. Old power struggles and buried patterns surface for review, not for punishment. What you truly let go of during this stretch tends to stay gone.
hookRows.notes: Retrograde season meaning. Sun/Moon never retrograde; nodes are nearly always retrograde so they get no retro copy.

hookRows.body_you: Old wounds reopen a little, not to hurt you again but to show you where healing stalled. Being gentle with yourself gets more done here than pushing through.
hookRows.body_they: Old wounds reopen a little, not to hurt you again but to show you where healing stalled. Being gentle with yourself gets more done here than pushing through.
